result.stdout:
USAGE:
    dev-pomo [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

OPTIONS:
                                      DEFAULT                                   
    -h, --help                                   Prints help information        
    -c, --cycles <POMODORO-CYCLES>    4          Defines how many iterations of 
                                                 pomodoros to run in a session  
                                                 (defaults to 4)                

COMMANDS:
    run-timer    Default command that runs the pomodoro timer      
    configure    Configure various properties of the pomodoro timer
